name: Unlabeled Sample Compression of Singletons
details: For a domain with at least two points.
proof: Fix a cyclic successor map.  If a realizable sample has a positive instance, retain it and reconstruct that singleton.  If it is all-negative, its instance set is a proper subset of the domain; retain a point whose successor lies outside that set and reconstruct the successor singleton.  This is consistent.  Size zero cannot distinguish two distinct singleton targets.
